durableFields.notes: The minimal creature attack subject stores actor and target combatant ids selected by the caller. Discovery admits this subject only for the current actor when it can take actions, has an available Attack action, and is a stat-block-origin creature with no structured action section; the subject does not encode authored monster, weapon, or fixture identity. Task replay fixtures use synthetic-test provenance rather than claiming SRD provenance.
The Attack Roll hole carries only the actor and target ids needed to return the public fill to the typed creatureAttack subject.
The Rolled Dice hole is emitted only after a public Attack Roll fill hits the target Armor Class.
Existing target Hit Points own the durable creature attack damage result. Task 67 applies damage through applyBattleHitPointDamage and does not introduce a parallel HP field.
Creature attack discovery route events are derived from the typed subject and Attack Roll initial hole.
Creature attack resolution route events are derived from submitted fill kind, hit/miss outcome, needed holes, Attack action eligibility, and resolved Hit Point damage.
The route subject is derived from typed BattleSubject shape, not from connector names or source action names.
Attack Roll fills route through battleAttackRoll; hit damage fills route through battleHitPoint. The owner is derived from public fill/result shape.

notes: Task 67 introduced no new durable BattleState fields.

The minimal creature attack pilot uses existing combatant ids, stat-block origin facts with synthetic-test fixture provenance in replay, current-turn action resources, Armor Class projection, BattleFill values, Hit Point state, and public routeEvents. Copied zero damage is represented as a creatureAttackZeroDamage fill, not as a forged positive die result or a global empty rolled-dice fill.
Route evidence records executable-boundary projection state only; it does not duplicate hit, damage, HP, target, or action state in a parallel ledger.
